name: bounds
description: The longest review PlayerVox answers, 8000 characters: folded to three lines, then unfolded in a list that scrolls while the count and the pager stay below it. A review of exactly 120 characters has no Read more, one of 121 has; so has a short review of four lines. A blank review shows no text, and a blank original is no translation. The count follows the user's number format.
